answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in willow, queued in jetty, and opal publishes the wait time. A farm of 173 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2025 identities would post 1543 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
